title: Two guards found nearly naked in the Echo area near Wall
place_text: Echo area, near Wall, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Before we got there, there was another case in in Wall, South Dakota, where two guys are it was in the Echo area, responded to another site

plain: In 1977, near Wall, South Dakota, two guards who had gone out to a site in what the Air Force called the Echo area were said to have been found nearly naked afterwards. An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods mentions the case on the show as something that happened before he and his fellow airmen got there: "two guys... in the Echo area, responded to another site." He brings it up as an earlier strange event at the same group of bases, before the encounter he says he lived through.
